mostWorthwhile.text: Building the living bone was most worthwhile: the nutrient channels and finished cutaway showed that bone contains living cells as well as hard material.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add bone cells directly to the reinforced fibres was confusing because the picture showed them inside bone, but the pairing was unavailable.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the cells had to be combined with blood vessels before they could join the bone material.

arbitrary.text: The required order for supplying the cells felt a little arbitrary at first. The vessel picture suggested the next pairing, but it hadn't explained why the direct combination was unavailable.

continue.text: Yes, I would choose to try another chapter. Seeing how cartilage, fluid and ligaments contribute different things to a working joint made me curious about what comes next.
